fonts.usage: Brand name, major headings (H1, H2), gallery titles. It brings the luxury, editorial feel.
UI elements, body text, control labels, prompts. Provides clean, geometric readability.

rules: Never use default generic fonts like Inter or Arial.
Headlines (Cormorant Garamond) must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) and be set in Regular or Medium weight.
UI Labels (Outfit) should be small (text-xs or text-sm) and slightly tracked out (tracking-wide) for uppercase labels.
Primary headings max size is text-5xl.
Backgrounds must be void black or very dark charcoal. Do not use pure black (#000000); use #050505.
Gold accents (#D4AF37) must be used sparingly for primary actions (Generate button, active states, active tab borders).
Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Rely on solid dark colors and glassmorphism.
DO NOT use teal green or teal blue.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/5' for panels, control sections, and modal cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: Keep borders extremely subtle. 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08).
visual_enhancers.noise: Add a subtle SVG noise overlay fixed to the screen to eliminate digital flatness, opacity 2-3%.

grids_layouts.three_column: Use 'react-resizable-panels' to create Left Sidebar (250px), Center Workspace (flex-1), Right Controls (350px).
grids_layouts.canvas: The center workspace must have generous padding (p-8 or p-12). Images should be displayed using CSS Grid (1-4 output count) taking maximum available height while maintaining aspect ratio.
grids_layouts.control_panel: Dense but optical layout. Group settings (Scene, Outfit, Format) using Accordions or sleek divided sections. No 'cards' in the control panel, just flat sections with subtle dividers.

components_instructions.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black font-medium hover:bg-[#F0C74A]. Secondary: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 text-white.
components_instructions.inputs: bg-black/50 border border-white/10 text-white placeholder:text-white/30 focus:border-[#D4AF37]/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37]/50. Use transparent or very dark backgrounds.
components_instructions.panels: The resizable handles should be 1px or 2px wide, colored transparent but showing a subtle line on hover.
components_instructions.scrollbars: Custom minimal scrollbars for panels: 4px width, transparent track, thumb-white/10.

motion.transitions: Use spring animations for hover states. 0.3s ease for color changes. Add transition to specific properties, never 'all'.
motion.loading: For AI image generation loading state, do NOT use a generic spinner. Use a slow, pulsing glass overlay on the placeholder, and an elegant progress bar at the top or bottom of the canvas.

generated_scene_chania.description: Generated output example for 'Chania Old Town' scene.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a desktop-first Lumina AI Studio. Force dark mode. Implement 3-column resizable layout using react-resizable-panels. The overall feel should be high-end, slow, precise, and luxurious.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Update globals.css/index.css to import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit'. Configure them in tailwind.config.js.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react but set strokeWidth={1} or {1.25} to make them look thin and premium.
instructions_to_main_agent.login_page: Create an elegant single-owner login screen. Deep background, centered glass card. No 'sign up' link, just login.
instructions_to_main_agent.identity_packs: UI for managing and uploading up to 5 reference photos per pack. Use grid for face thumbnails.
instructions_to_main_agent.new_generation: Center canvas displays a grid (1x1, 1x2, or 2x2) of the output. The right control panel has the intricate form (Prompt textarea, Presets for Scene and Clothing, Aspect ratio toggles).
instructions_to_main_agent.gallery: A masonry or strict grid view of past generations with hover actions (favorite, download).
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT center align generic App containers. Maintain strict layout.
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react thin stroke icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8) than standard SaaS templates.
Apply backdrop-blur-xl and low opacity borders (border-white/10) to create depth without gradients.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on interactive elements.
Do not use generic 'card' component everywhere. Rely on subtle borders and layout density.
Ensure the Tailwind Config handles the custom fonts and color variables.
Add transition for hover states but NEVER transition: all.
